lines.text: Oh! I didn't realize that was a problem. I'll take care of it this week.
{owner} seems genuinely surprised. A rare and pleasant feeling.

choices.label: Thank them
choices.reply: Appreciate it. The notice has the details.
choices.result: Neighborly.

choices.label: Offer a short extension
choices.reply: Take another week if you need it.
choices.result: Extension noted. Goodwill earned.

choices.label: Stand firm
choices.reply: The deadline stands as written.
choices.result: Polite, but cooler.

lines.text: My mother lost her apartment. She's staying with us for two weeks. Please.
{owner} holds a folder that may or may not contain documentation.

choices.label: Ask for documentation
choices.reply: Send me something in writing and I'll note the file.
choices.result: Reasonable. Residents appreciate a paper trail.

choices.label: Grant an extension
choices.reply: Two weeks. Please keep me posted.
choices.result: Kind. Some neighbors may call it favoritism.

choices.label: Rules are rules
choices.reply: I'm sorry. The process has to be the same for everyone.
choices.result: Consistent, and cold.

lines.text: YOU TOOK A PICTURE OF MY LAWN?
The notice lists the measurement.
THEN MEASURE STEVE'S. HE HAS A JUNGLE.

choices.label: Explain the process
choices.reply: Every complaint is inspected the same way. If Steve's is reported, he'll be visited.
choices.result: They grumble, but they heard you.

choices.label: Promise to check Steve's
choices.reply: Fair point. I'll look at it next.
choices.result: A promise is a promise. Don't forget it.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.reply: Have a good afternoon.
choices.result: They shout the rest at your back.

choices.label: Threaten a fine
choices.reply: Keep this up and the next letter has a number in it.
choices.result: A neighbor starts filming.

lines.text: Funny how the rules only seem to apply to some of us.
{owner} keeps a spreadsheet. It is color-coded.

choices.label: Acknowledge it
choices.reply: You're right to ask. I'll review how these are handled.
choices.result: Honest, and humbling.

choices.label: Deny it
choices.reply: Every case is handled on the facts.
choices.result: The spreadsheet says otherwise.

choices.label: End conversation
choices.reply: I'm done here. Good day.
choices.result: They'll bring it to the next meeting.

footer: THIS MAY COME UP AT THE NEXT MEETING.

lines.text: Go ahead. Say it again. I'm recording this for my attorney.
The phone has a tiny red dot. So does your forehead, metaphorically.

choices.label: Stay professional
choices.reply: Please see the notice. I'll be on my way.
choices.result: Boring footage. Excellent outcome.

choices.label: Wave at the camera
choices.reply: Hi, everyone! Mind the HOA bylaws!
choices.result: It will go viral in a four-house radius.

choices.label: Ask them to stop
choices.reply: I'd rather not be filmed, please.
choices.result: They film a little closer.

footer: A CLIP IS CIRCULATING IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD CHAT.

lines.text: A very fast dog appears from behind the hedge.
BISCUIT, NO! DROP THE CLIPBOARD!
Biscuit does not drop the clipboard. Biscuit has a vision.

choices.label: Chase the dog
choices.reply: That's evidence! Biscuit, come back!
choices.result: You lose ten minutes, a shoe, and your dignity.

choices.label: Offer a treat
choices.reply: Biscuit. Biscuit. Who's a good dog?
choices.result: Clipboard returned, slightly chewed.

choices.label: Let the dog have it
choices.reply: Keep it. Lots of paperwork anyway.
choices.result: Biscuit is now an unofficial committee member.

lines.text: As you can see in the notice, the lawn—
Every sprinkler in the yard turns on at once. They are all aimed at you.
...The timer is a new feature.

choices.label: Finish the sentence
choices.reply: —needs attention. Thank you.
choices.result: Professionalism, soaked through.

choices.label: Retreat dramatically
choices.reply: I'll be going now!
choices.result: You slip on the mulch. Nobody saw. Everyone saw.

footer: THIS MAY COME UP AT THE NEXT MEETING.

lines.text: The notice explains the—
A leaf blower starts up next door. Conversation becomes interpretive.
WHAT? I CAN'T HEAR YOU OVER MY NEIGHBOR!

choices.label: Shout the rules
choices.reply: THE DEADLINE IS ON THE NOTICE!
choices.result: Everyone on the street now knows your business.

choices.label: Hand over the notice
choices.reply: (Gestures at paper.)
choices.result: Understood in mime. Efficient.

choices.label: Visit the neighbor
choices.reply: (Points sternly at the blower.)
choices.result: You've started something. Possibly a second case.

lines.text: This is harassment!
A neighbor appears in a bathrobe with opinions about the mailbox.
And while you're here, have you SEEN what the Hendersons did to their gutters?

choices.label: De-escalate
choices.reply: Let's take it one issue at a time. I'll note everything.
choices.result: Two grievances now filed, calmly.

choices.label: Refer to a hearing
choices.reply: Anyone with a concern is welcome at the next meeting.
choices.result: They'll take you up on that.

choices.label: Raise your voice
choices.reply: EVERYONE, PLEASE STOP SHOUTING!
choices.result: Nobody stops shouting.

lines.text: I had coffee with the Treasurer on Tuesday. She mentioned you'd be... understanding.
The phone buzzes. It's the Treasurer. Of course it is.

choices.label: Hold the line
choices.reply: I appreciate the friendship. The notice stands.
choices.result: Principled, and a director will remember it.

choices.label: Quietly look the other way
choices.reply: I'll see what I can do.
choices.result: Easy now. Hard to explain later.

lines.text: A delivery van parks itself precisely between you and the evidence.
That's, uh, a coincidence. I swear.

choices.label: Wait it out
choices.reply: I'll stand here. Take your time.
choices.result: Eleven minutes pass. The van leaves. So does your patience.

choices.label: Photograph the van
choices.reply: Well, that's documented too.
choices.result: You have the best photo of a van in HOA history.

lines.text: A dog escapes. The inspector runs. A sprinkler activates.
A delivery vehicle brakes dramatically. The inspector, regrettably, does not.
The inspector lies stunned, in the way only cartoons allow. A neighbor sprints out with a blanket.
Another resident films everything. Someone has already called the board secretary.

choices.label: Insist you're fine
choices.reply: I'm fine! This is fine! Everything's within code!
choices.result: Nobody believes you. The blanket stays on.

choices.label: Ask for the video
choices.reply: Please never post that.
choices.result: It's already up. It has a soundtrack.

footer: THIS MAY COME UP AT THE NEXT MEETING.

lines.text: You're not really with the HOA. Who sent you? Is this about the satellite dish?
{owner} peers at your clipboard as if it might be recording.

choices.label: Show your badge
choices.reply: Here's the board resolution naming me president.
choices.result: They photograph it. Twice.

choices.label: Play along
choices.reply: I can neither confirm nor deny anything about dishes.
choices.result: They nod gravely. You have a new friend, or an informant.

choices.label: Leave the notice
choices.reply: The details are on the paper. Good day.
choices.result: The notice is inspected for hidden cameras.

lines.text: Oh, no, it's FINE. I'm sure the rules are very important to you.
{owner} smiles in a way that will appear in the next newsletter's comments.

choices.label: Take them at their word
choices.reply: Great. Thanks for understanding.
choices.result: It was not understanding.

choices.label: Ask what's wrong
choices.reply: It sounds like something's bothering you. Want to talk it through?
choices.result: Forty minutes later you know about the gutters, the HOA fee and the divorce.

choices.label: Stay on topic
choices.reply: I'd just like to confirm the cure date.
choices.result: A card arrives the next day. It is unsigned.

lines.text: The gnomes are load-bearing. If you remove one, the whole lawn collapses spiritually.
{owner} wears a wizard hat. Nobody has asked about it.

choices.label: Accept the gnomes
choices.reply: The gnomes may stay.
choices.result: A gnome has been added to your Christmas card list.

choices.label: Ask for a plan
choices.reply: Could you map where each gnome goes?
choices.result: The map is beautiful. It is also a scroll.

choices.label: Hold the line
choices.reply: Gnomes are allowed. The grass is not.
choices.result: The wizard hat is removed in disgust.

lines.text: Wait, was that this week? I put the letter somewhere very safe.
{owner} begins looking in the freezer.

choices.label: Hand over a copy
choices.reply: Here's a fresh copy. The date is circled.
choices.result: Gratitude, and a fridge magnet.

choices.label: Offer a reminder call
choices.reply: I'll text you on the day.
choices.result: Helpful. Slightly overstepping.

choices.label: Stand firm
choices.reply: The date is the date.
choices.result: They find the letter in the freezer. It's cold, but legible.

lines.text: You return to your golf cart. A van has parked in front of it. A neighbor has parked a lawn chair behind it.
I'm not saying it's a barricade. I'm saying it's a *position*.

choices.label: Ask nicely
choices.reply: Could someone move a van, please?
choices.result: The van moves in nine minutes. The chair, never.

choices.label: Take the long way
choices.reply: I'll walk. It's good for the soul.
choices.result: You do. It isn't.

footer: THIS MAY COME UP AT THE NEXT MEETING.

lines.text: Oh, hi! I saw you coming up the street. Is this about the thing?
{owner} is friendly. That will not last.

choices.label: Yes, a complaint came in
choices.reply: A report was filed. I'd like to take a look.
choices.result: They step aside, a little nervous.

choices.label: Just a routine check
choices.reply: Routine walk-through. Won't take long.
choices.result: They relax. Possibly too much.

lines.text: Nobody answers the door. A curtain moves anyway.
A note on the mailbox reads: 'BACK AT 5. DO NOT TOUCH THE GNOME.'

choices.label: Proceed with the inspection
choices.reply: I'll look from the curb.
choices.result: Within your rights. Nobody can say you didn't knock.

choices.label: Leave a courtesy card
choices.reply: (Leaves a card with a friendly note.)
choices.result: The card is quietly appreciated.

lines.text: I'm the one who called. I've got photos, dates, and a timeline.
{owner} hands you a folder. It is color-tabbed.

choices.label: Take the folder
choices.reply: Thank you. I'll review it.
choices.result: They stand there while you review it.

choices.label: Decline politely
choices.reply: I'll form my own view, thanks.
choices.result: They sigh like a kettle.

lines.text: Funny how {favored}'s violation has been sitting there for months. But here you are. At MY house.
{owner} has a point, and knows it.

choices.label: Admit the inconsistency
choices.reply: You're right to raise it. I'll look into {favored}'s too.
choices.result: A promise. Keep it.

choices.label: Deflect
choices.reply: I can only speak to this property today.
choices.result: They write it down.

footer: THIS MAY COME UP AT THE NEXT MEETING.

lines.text: Funny how {favored}'s violation hasn't been touched, but mine gets a letter in four days.
The mailman, pretending not to listen, listens.

choices.label: Review {favored}'s case
choices.reply: Fair. I'll make sure the standard is the same.
choices.result: Credibility, cautiously restored.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.result: Silence reads as a yes.

lines.text: BISCUIT! THE INSPECTOR IS NOT A SQUIRREL!
The inspector runs. The dog runs faster. The mud is a surprise to everyone.
The inspector slides. Briefly, spectacularly.

choices.label: Get up with dignity
choices.reply: I'm fine. The notice is on the door.
choices.result: A neighbor starts a slow clap.

choices.label: Stay down a minute
choices.reply: I'm going to lie here for a bit.
choices.result: Someone brings a towel and a lemonade.

lines.text: A gust catches a ten-foot inflatable turkey. It makes a break for the street.
STOP THAT TURKEY! IT'S ALSO A COMPLIANCE ISSUE!

choices.label: Chase the turkey
choices.reply: Come back here!
choices.result: You catch it at the stop sign. It's heavier than it looks.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.reply: It's the turkey's decision.
choices.result: It was seen near the clubhouse. Nobody could stop it.

footer: THIS MAY COME UP AT THE NEXT MEETING.

lines.text: I'm not blocking the driveway. I'm just... arranging seating.
Five lawn chairs form a perfect line. Nobody is sitting in them.

choices.label: Sit in a chair
choices.reply: Mind if I join?
choices.result: An unexpected truce, and a lemonade.

choices.label: Remove a chair
choices.reply: The notice is about the driveway.
choices.result: They remove four. Technically a concession.

lines.text: A large blue tarp has appeared over the vehicle in question, tied with enormous confidence.
What vehicle? I see no vehicle.

choices.label: Lift the tarp
choices.reply: Let's take a look.
choices.result: It is, in fact, a vehicle.

choices.label: Note it and move on
choices.reply: I'll note the tarp.
choices.result: Tarp noted. Dignity preserved.

lines.text: No no no—that's not my lawn! THAT'S NOT MY LAWN!
A landscaper mows a very precise line through the wrong yard.

choices.label: Stop the crew
choices.reply: Please stop! Wrong address!
choices.result: The crew apologizes. The lawn is now two-toned.

choices.label: Photograph it
choices.reply: I'll document this for the vendor.
choices.result: Excellent evidence. Terrible lawn.

lines.text: A neighbor, mid-yell, is mistaken by a passerby for a disturbance. Someone calls it in.
A police car arrives. The officer looks at the clipboard, then at the lawn, then at everyone.
The officer asks the only reasonable question: 'Over... grass?'

choices.label: Explain calmly
choices.reply: It's an HOA matter. Nobody's in danger.
choices.result: The officer leaves with the faint look of someone updating a mental file.

choices.label: Apologize to everyone
choices.reply: My apologies for the confusion, all around.
choices.result: Everyone leaves faintly embarrassed.

footer: A POLICE REPORT HAS BEEN FILED.

lines.text: I'M FINE! I JUST TRIPPED OVER THE FINE! THE LETTER! THE ACTUAL LETTER!
An ambulance arrives for a resident who is, in fact, fine.
Paramedics wrap them in a blanket anyway. Three people film. The board secretary is already typing.

choices.label: Offer a ride to the clubhouse
choices.reply: Let me at least drive you somewhere shaded.
choices.result: The golf cart carries one blanket-wrapped homeowner. It is not a parade, but it looks like one.

choices.label: Slip away
choices.reply: (Backs away slowly.)
choices.result: You are spotted. Of course you are spotted.

footer: THIS MAY COME UP AT THE NEXT MEETING.

lines.text: An inattentive driver, glued to a podcast, bumps the inspector at roughly the speed of a brisk walk.
The inspector goes down in the grand tradition of cartoons: stars, a fluttering clipboard, one slow-motion shoe.
Neighbors rush over with a blanket. A dog helps. Someone films all of it.

choices.label: Insist you're fine
choices.reply: I am FINE. Everyone is FINE. Please do not post that.
choices.result: They post it. It has a laugh track.

choices.label: Ask for a paper towel
choices.reply: I'll take a paper towel and a moment of silence.
choices.result: A very polite crowd forms. Nobody leaves.

footer: A RESIDENT HAS FILED AN INSURANCE CLAIM.

lines.text: I fixed it! I fixed all of it! Check the back too!
{owner} has not been this proud since the school science fair.

choices.label: Congratulate them
choices.reply: Great work. It looks good.
choices.result: Neighborhood morale ticks up.

choices.label: Remind them about maintenance
choices.reply: Keep it up through the season.
choices.result: They nod. Genuinely.

lines.text: I just wanted the yard to look nice for my daughter's wedding. I'm sorry.
{owner} dabs their eyes with a gardening glove.

choices.label: Offer a payment plan
choices.reply: We can spread it over two months.
choices.result: Relief floods the porch.

choices.label: Stay firm
choices.reply: I understand, but the fine stands.
choices.result: Painfully correct.
